_comment_1: Quaggasklip (Metron) detector overrides. Any key here replaces
_comment_2: the default in quaggasklip_detector.py Config. Unknown keys and
_comment_3: out-of-range values are logged and ignored, never fatal.
_comment_station: Must match the station the admin assigned to the Quaggasklip tenant.
_comment_spi: Thunder Click in mikroBUS socket 1 -> CS is GPIO8 = CE0 -> spi device 0.
_comment_irq: Socket 1 INT on the Pi 2 shield = GPIO6. CONFIRM with find_irq_pin.py before deploying. Never 12: GPIO12 is not routed to either socket on a Pi 2 shield, so it cannot work.
_comment_pulse: Optional strike pulse for a Campbell pulse-count channel. Must be a SOCKET 2 pin to reach a screw terminal, because socket 1 is under the Thunder Click. GPIO19 is socket 2 RST on Terminal 2 Click TB1 pin 7, which is what the CR300 program expects. GPIO17 (socket 2 PWM, TB2 pin 2) is the alternative. GPIO18 cannot work here.
_comment_campbell: Terminal 2 Click in socket 2. TX/RX are GPIO14/15, shared by both sockets, so this is the Pi hardware UART either way. Use transport 'bitbang' with campbell_tx_pin only if the boot config cannot be changed.
_comment_txpin: Bit-bang fallback only. GPIO26 is socket 2 INT, which lands on Terminal 2 Click TB2 pin 3, so it does reach a terminal.
_comment_sensor: Lower thresholds than GWLD1: this is not a smelter site. Raise if the log fills with NOISE or DISTURBER events.
_comment_panel: Set alert_webhook_token to the value held by the panel. Do NOT reuse another site's token.
_comment_stratus: Optional Stratus Weather ingest. Leave disabled until an endpoint exists.
